definitions.gloss: to trigger; to induce; to cause; to provoke
definitions.explanation: To cause something (usually negative) to occur as a consequence. Often used in medical, scientific, and news contexts for events that set off a chain reaction or bring about an undesirable outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する。
⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk that heavy rain will trigger landslides.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連鎖的|れんさてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}して、⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: One accident triggered a chain of other accidents, causing a major traffic jam.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
A ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ B ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する (A triggers/induces B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する (to trigger an accident)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する (to induce illness)
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する (to trigger allergies)
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誘発|ゆうはつ}する (to trigger an earthquake)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧: To cause, to bring about — more general and common in everyday speech.
- ⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: To invite, to bring upon oneself — implies the cause was avoidable or negligent.
- ⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧: To urge, to promote — neutral, often positive, unlike ⟦{誘発|ゆうはつ}→誘発：14240_yuuhatsu⟧ which tends toward negative outcomes.
